# ASA Biopharm 2026 RISW SC06: Improving Power and Precision in Randomized Trials Using Covariate Adjustment

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This contains the materials for [ASA Biopharm RISW Short Course SC06: Improving Power and Precision in Randomized Trials Using Covariate Adjustment](https://ww2.amstat.org/meetings/risw/2026/shortcourses.cfm)

  - [1. Overview on Covariate Adjustment](https://github.com/CovariateAdjustment/RISW2026)
  - [2. Software & Code for Covariate Adjustment](https://github.com/CovariateAdjustment/RISW2026)
  - [3. Covariate Adjustment in Group Sequential Designs](https://github.com/CovariateAdjustment/RISW2026)
  - [4. Information Adapative Designs](https://github.com/CovariateAdjustment/RISW2026)
  - [5. Examples: Continuous, Binary, Ordinal, Time-to-Event](https://github.com/CovariateAdjustment/RISW2026)
  
[Use this link to download the repo in a .zip file](https://github.com/CovariateAdjustment/RISW2026)
